audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Riven, Skill, Sion, Sion, Riven, Sion, Sion — it handed Sion levels 3-5 and first item in a lane the same page describes as Riven's throughout, and it gave her level 1 where neither champion can commit.
audit.why: The packet chart is Skill, Riven, Riven, Riven, Riven, Riven, Skill and the mirror has already flipped rows 0 and 6 to Skill and rows 1, 2, 3 and 5 to Riven. A 48.36% win rate over 2229 games fits a lane Riven leads until Sion's bulk equalises.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 2, 3, 5 and 6 flipped as matched pairs in both layers with ratings re-pointed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Broken Wings is described as 'three Q dashes' whose 'dash count resets on ability use', and Blade of the Exile as an ability that 'doubles her AD and adds a ranged execute'.
audit.why: Broken Wings (Q, 13s, 275 range) is one ability reactivatable three times inside a short window, with the third hit knocking back — there is no reset-on-ability-use in Riot's description. Blade of the Exile (R, 120/90/60) grants bonus attack damage and range and one use of Wind Slash; nothing states a doubling or an execute threshold.
audit.corrected: Rotation restated as Broken Wings into Ki Burst into Valor with real cooldowns; the ultimate described as AD, range and a single Wind Slash rather than a doubling execute.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown appeared anywhere despite 'track Ki Burst' being the page's stated win condition.
audit.why: Ki Burst is 11/10/9/8/7 at 260 range, Broken Wings a flat 13, Valor 10/9/8/7/6, Blade of the Exile 120 at rank 1. The 11-second Ki Burst is the window every trade rule points at.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into early, spikes[0], spikes[1], whys[4], mid and wants.foe[1].

edits.before: E-poke and W-shield trades cost him more than you. Identify how Riven contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Neither of you can commit at level 1 — Broken Wings is 13 seconds and your charge is too slow to punish an attentive Riven.

edits.before: Riven hits level 2 with three Q dashes available and immediately sidesteps your charged Q telegraph, closing inside your stun range and bursting through your half-stacked W-shield.
edits.after: At level 2 Broken Wings gives her three chained strikes she can steer around your telegraph, closing inside your charge and bursting through a half-stacked Soul Furnace.

edits.before: Full Q-Q-Q-W-E rotation is online and her combo resolves faster than your Q charge — she wins the extended trade and can dash out before your shield detonates.
edits.after: Broken Wings into Ki Burst into Valor is online and resolves faster than your Q charge — she wins the extended trade and steps out before your shield detonates.

edits.before: Riven's R doubles her AD and adds a ranged execute shot — committing Unstoppable Onslaught into a Riven with ultimate up is a nearly guaranteed death.
edits.after: Blade of the Exile (120s at rank 1) adds attack damage and range plus one Wind Slash — charging Unstoppable Onslaught into a Riven holding it is death.

edits.before: Riven's Q-Q-Q-W rotation comes online and she can burst you through your W-shield before it fully stacks — respect the combo window or die for free.
edits.after: Broken Wings into Ki Burst (11s at rank 1) comes online and bursts you before Soul Furnace matters — respect the window or die for free.

edits.before: Riven's R (Blade of the Exile) doubles her AD and gives her a ranged execute that punishes your Unstoppable Onslaught commit — don't R into a Riven who has ultimate up.
edits.after: Blade of the Exile (120s at rank 1) gives her bonus attack damage, extra range and one Wind Slash — never charge Unstoppable Onslaught into a Riven holding it.

edits.before: Level 1 is a coin flip — she can E-poke and reset out before your W-shield stacks, but a full-charge Q from brush punishes her if she stands still. The problem is she rarely stands still: her three Q dashes at level 2 let her sidestep your telegraph completely and burst inside your charge time. Respect the level 2 power spike and do not commit a charged Q into a Riven who still has all three Q dashes available — she will dash through it and stun you with W (Ki Burst) before your shield detonates. Farm safely, hold your W for incoming burst rather than using it aggressively, and only trade when you confirm her Ki Burst is on cooldown.
edits.after: Level 1 is a coin flip — she can poke and step out before your W-shield stacks, but a full-charge Q from brush punishes her if she stands still. The problem is she rarely stands still: Broken Wings at level 2 chains three strikes she can steer around your telegraph and burst you inside your charge time. Respect the level 2 spike and do not commit a charged Q into a Riven with Broken Wings unspent — she moves through it and stuns you with Ki Burst before your shield detonates. Farm safely, hold your W for incoming burst rather than using it aggressively, and only trade once Ki Burst is on cooldown, which is 11 seconds at rank 1.

edits.before: Levels 4 through 6 she owns the lane rhythm entirely. Her Q dash count resets on ability use, she can chain three dashes plus W stun plus E shield in one rotation faster than your charged Q resolves — and at level 6 her R (Blade of the Exile) adds AD and a ranged execute that punishes your Unstoppable Onslaught commit hard. Do not R into a Riven who has her ultimate up. The correct mid-game pattern is wave management: keep your HP topped, use Unstoppable Onslaught only as a positional escape or to reach a clearly winning angle, and farm toward your first item without gifting her a gold lead she can snowball.
edits.after: Levels 4 through 6 she owns the lane rhythm entirely. Broken Wings chains three strikes on a 13-second cooldown, and she follows with Ki Burst's stun and Valor's dash-block faster than your charged Q resolves — and at level 6 Blade of the Exile adds attack damage, range and a single Wind Slash that punishes your Unstoppable Onslaught commit hard. Do not R into a Riven who has her ultimate up. The correct mid-game pattern is wave management: keep your HP topped, use Unstoppable Onslaught only as a positional escape or to reach a clearly winning angle, and farm toward your first item without gifting her a gold lead she can snowball.

edits.before: Use her three Q dashes to sidestep your charged Q and close inside your stun range where you cannot charge it
edits.after: Steer Broken Wings around your charge arc to close inside your swing where you cannot re-aim it again

edits.before: Activate W (Ki Burst) mid-combo to stun you out of your W-shield detonation and erase your defensive tool
edits.after: Land Ki Burst (11s at rank 1) mid-combo to stun you out of the Soul Furnace detonation window entirely

notes: Carried over unverified from the mirror and NOT asserted here: whether Ki Burst's stun cancels a charging Decimating Smash.
